key_insight: β-OPSD generalizes vanilla OPSD by treating the KL anchor as a tunable β, and its optimal policy becomes a geometric interpolation between a reference model and a privileged teacher.
engineering_relevance: This makes self-distillation more stable and controllable for reasoning LMs, while preserving the efficiency of distillation instead of expensive RL optimization.
method: Derive β-OPSD as a policy-optimization objective with β weighting the KL penalty to the reference policy.
Use the closed-form optimal policy as a distillation target by mixing token-level logits from the reference and teacher.
Apply return-to-go credit assignment to better align token updates with sequence-level reasoning performance.
evidence_signal: Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show consistent gains over vanilla OPSD in both optimization stability and downstream reasoning performance.
watch_item: Direct RL optimization of the β-OPSD objective is high-variance and costly, so the distilled approximation still depends on careful logit-mixing and credit-assignment implementation.
paper_title: $β$-OPSD: Deriving with Policy Optimization, Training with Self-Distillation
